title: Honey Trap
description: A new weapon that drops honey jars: grizzlies stop to eat for 2 s and every other bear slows in the puddle.

title: Liquidation Combo
description: Kill bears within 1 s of each other to build a combo; at 10x the screen shouts 10X LEVERAGED and the streak's candles pay double.

title: Play as The Whale
description: A third character: 140 HP, slow, every candle on screen drifts toward you, and you start with Buyback.
